name: Zendikar Rising
scope: Raw canonical scan geometry only: no renderer tuning, no per-scan transform, no color/saturation matching. Same fixed edge windows for every set; uncertain edges excluded with their measurements retained. Balanced small diagnostic sample, not a full-set census.
selection: First three high-resolution ordinary nonlegendary normal cards per W/U/B/R/G/artifact/land/gold bucket, frozen before viewing scans. Special treatments and special layouts excluded.

scaleProfile.scope: First two U/B/R/G cards per color calibrate one uniform set/frame scale from outer rails; third cards validate. Art-window vertical span is a rejection check, never a fitted scale target. No card-specific scale, rotation, or anisotropic warp. Failed fits retain unit scale. This does not establish physical printing dimensions.
